title: FirstService Residential Selected to Manage Bower Hill at Mt. Lebanon, Expanding Its Pittsburgh High-Rise Presence
body_markdown:
# FirstService Residential Selected to Manage Bower Hill at Mt. Lebanon, Expanding Its Pittsburgh High-Rise Presence


Thursday November 19, 2026


FirstService Residential, North America's leading residential community management company, has been selected to provide full-service property management for Bower Hill, a luxury high-rise community in the Mt. Lebanon section of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Previously self-managed, the community sought a partner with a proven record of successfully onboarding and managing similar communities and chose FirstService Residential.


This luxury high-rise community offers residents beautiful private walkways, a pool, a guest suite, a 24-hour fitness center, party rooms, a parking garage, and a solarium. Its prime location in the Mt. Lebanon section of suburban Pittsburgh provides a peaceful setting just minutes from a mix of retail and restaurants.


"We are thrilled to continue growing our presence in the Pittsburgh market and to welcome Bower Hill to the FirstService Residential family," said Michael Mendillo, President, East Region, FirstService Residential. "We look forward to sharing our depth of resources with the team there and creating an outstanding resident experience."


"We've already begun working closely with the board during this process and look forward to continuing to work together to enhance operations, support residents, and help achieve their long-term goals," said Andrew Sytnik, Vice President, High-Rise, FirstService Residential.


As the leading residential community management company, FirstService Residential partners with boards and residents to enhance property values, enrich community living, and deliver customized solutions designed to meet each community's unique needs. Through local expertise, innovative resources, and a commitment to service excellence, FirstService Residential helps communities achieve their vision while creating lasting value for the future.


**About FirstService Residential**
FirstService Residential is simplifying property management. Its hospitality-minded teams serve residential communities across the United States and Canada. The organization partners with boards, owners, and developers to enhance the value of every property and the life of every resident.


Leveraging unique expertise and scale, FirstService serves its clients with proven solutions and a service-first philosophy. Residents can count on 24/7 customer care and tailored lifestyle programming, amenity activation, and technology for their community’s specific needs. Market-leading programs with FirstService Financial, FirstService Energy, and special districts teams deliver additional levels of support.


Boards and developers select FirstService Residential to realize their vision and drive positive change for residents in the communities in their trusted care.


FirstService Residential is a subsidiary of FirstService Corporation (NASDAQ and TSX: FSV), a North American leader in providing essential property services to a wide range of residential and commercial clients.


Nov 19, 2026
